Lina (Partnerships): Quick idea 1011 1SI Field Labs: Hyperdrive1 1half-day practical certification for systems integrators. Focus pillars: marketplace deploy, private/VPC onboarding, and hardware partner acceptance tests. Thinking stations + timed challenges. Thoughts?
Marco (SI Programs): Love it. Practical > slides. Suggest 4 stations (marketplace listing deploy, infra & KMS onboarding, observability triage, hardware-in-the-loop smoke tests). 30m per station + 15m handoff = 2.5h total per cohort.
Priya (DevEx): We should require partners to bring a short app manifest and service account. Also will need a golden example repo + infra-as-code templates. I'll drop a starter template.
Ben (Legal): Heads-up: any demo accounts that access customer data need a signed DPA/NDA. For sandbox creds that use synthetic data it's OK but we still need the marketplace TOU checked. I'll review the intake form.
Hannah (Marketplace): We can do a simulated listing flow in a sandbox marketplace account. Need to confirm partner can register an escrow contact and upload the basic manifest. I'll coordinate sandbox tenants.
Lina (Partnerships): Good call Ben/Hannah. Who owns the scoring rubric for cert pass/fail? I propose Marco + Priya create a rubric (technical checklist + troubleshooting points) and we issue a digital badge for passing all 4 stations.
Marco (SI Programs): I'll draft rubric. Minimum pass: 3/4 stations + evidence (screenshots/logs). Also allow reattempt within 7 days.
Priya (DevEx): Proctors: we need 4 internal leads to run stations. Volunteers?
Lina (Partnerships): I'll take station 1 (marketplace deploy). Marco -> station 2?
Marco (SI Programs): I'll take infra & KMS (station 2). Priya -> observability station?
Priya (DevEx): Yup, observability & debug station is mine. Hannah -> hardware acceptance station?
Hannah (Marketplace): I can coordinate with HW partners but need an HW engineer to be present. I'll reach out to Aamir from HW partnerships.
DeployBot: calendar invite created for 2026-05-05 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT) and rehearsal slot 2026-05-03 16:00 UTC. Recording disabled by default for partner privacy.
Lina (Partnerships): Logistics: cohorts of 6 (3 partner teams) to keep proctor ratio 1:2. We'll run 3 cohorts that day. Need lab sandboxes: one per team. Priya can you provide sandbox provisioning CLI?
Priya (DevEx): Yup. Example provision command for a sandbox project:
```bash
# create sandbox project + demo user
redwoodctl sandbox create --org demo-sis --name "hyperdrive-team-1" --kms=projects/demo/locations/global/keyRings/demo/cryptoKeys/demo-key
```
Priya (DevEx): I'll also add a short preflight script partners run to verify connectivity and credentials.
Ben (Legal): Please include a checkbox on intake form confirming partners will only use synthetic/test data in sandboxes. I'll add wording.
Lina (Partnerships): Intake form fields: partner name, lead email, desired cohort, required OS/hw specs, sandbox contact, signed DPA checkbox. Marco will share the registration URL.
Marco (SI Programs): I'll spin up registration page and email workflow. Deadline to register: 2026-04-28.
Priya (DevEx): Rehearsal plan: end-to-end run with proctors + one internal test partner. Suggested time: Mon 2026-05-03 16:00 UTC. Who can join?
Lina (Partnerships): I can. Marco?
Marco (SI Programs): I'll be there. Hannah: please ask HW eng to join for the hardware station rehearsal.
Hannah (Marketplace): On it. Also note: marketplace sandbox quotas need bump; I'll request quota increases from infra by EOD Tue.
Lina (Partnerships): Communication plan: pre-read + one-pager, a 10m orientation at start, then stations. Capture pass screenshots in a shared folder. We'll send results + badge link within 48h.
Marco (SI Programs): Badges: we'll use existing LMS to issue badges via API. Priya, can you include an exportable evidence bundle (logs + screenshots) that the LMS can ingest?
Priya (DevEx): Yep, will standardize a zip with metadata. Example manifest field: participant_email, station_id, result, artifacts_url.
Lina (Partnerships): Risk check: legal sign-off, marketplace sandbox creds, hardware availability. Ben/Hannah confirm by Tue.
Ben (Legal): Confirmed I'll review intake wording by Tue noon.
Hannah (Marketplace): I'll confirm sandbox tenants and HW eng by Tue EOD.
Lina (Partnerships): Action items: Marco -> registration page + rubric (due 2026-04-24); Priya -> starter repo + sandbox CLI + evidence manifest (due 2026-04-26); Ben -> intake legal language (due 2026-04-21); Hannah -> sandbox quota + HW eng contact (due 2026-04-22); Lina -> one-pager + orientation deck (due 2026-04-23). DeployBot: reminders set for each assignee 72h before due date.
Marco (SI Programs): One more thing: can we include a short "marketplace listing checklist" card partners can keep after the session? I'll draft it.
Lina (Partnerships): Nice. Also let's collect qualitative feedback via a 4-question post-lab form (time-to-complete, clarity, blocker encountered, NPS). Priya can wire the form to auto-send after cohort.
Priya (DevEx): Will do.
Lina (Partnerships): Cool. If no objections, we'll lock this plan and start outreach tomorrow. :rocket:
Marco (SI Programs): No objections. Excited to get SIs hands-on.
Ben (Legal): All good from my side pending small wording tweaks.
Hannah (Marketplace): Sounds good. I'll ping Aamir and update here.
